sloka: तस्य मे कृच्छ्रभूतस्य कृच्छ्रादस्माद्विमोचय ।अन्येषां न गतिर्ह्यत्र कुम्भयोनिमृते द्विजम् ।। ७.७८.२३ ॥
transliteration: tasya me kṛcchrabhūtasya kṛcchrādasmādvimocaya ।anyeṣāṁ na gatirhyatra kumbhayonimṛte dvijam ।। 7.78.23 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, release me, who am in this great distress, from this predicament, for indeed, there is no other way or refuge here for anyone except the pot-born brahmin (Agastya).
